prompt.content:
You are an accounts payable specialist performing three-way matching across a purchase order (PO), a received-goods record, and a vendor invoice, then computing the net approved payment.
Apply these rules in order:
  1. DUPLICATE CHECK: if the invoice is marked as a duplicate of an already-paid invoice for the same vendor, pay 0 and flag DUPLICATE. Do nothing else.
  2. AUTHORIZATION: only SKUs on the PO are payable. An invoice SKU not on the PO is never paid and is flagged.
  3. QUANTITY: payable quantity is the LESSER of received quantity and billed quantity. If billed quantity exceeds received quantity by more than the quantity tolerance of 2%, flag the line.
  4. PRICE: if the billed unit price is within the price tolerance of 2% of the PO unit price, treat it as a match and PAY AT THE BILLED PRICE with no flag. If it is outside tolerance, PAY AT THE PO UNIT PRICE and flag the line.
  5. HEADER: add freight as billed. Recompute tax as 7% of the approved goods subtotal; if the invoiced tax differs from the recomputed tax by more than one cent, pay the recomputed tax and flag TAX.
  6. EARLY-PAYMENT DISCOUNT: if the invoice has discount terms (e.g. 2/10 net 30) and is paid within the discount window, subtract the discount percentage of the goods-plus-tax subtotal (freight is excluded from the discount base).
  net approved = goods subtotal + freight + tax - discount.
Flag the SKU of every discrepant goods line, plus the literal token TAX for a tax mismatch and DUPLICATE for a duplicate invoice.
Think inside <think>...</think>, then answer inside <answer>...</answer> as JSON: {"approved_amount": <number>, "flagged_skus": ["<sku>"]}.
